subject.title: Generalize post-timeout compaction completion reconciliation across session state

question: Should OpenClaw promote the existing compaction-count-only late-success repair into an authoritative compaction completion reconciliation boundary, and which session fields should that boundary own?
rationale: The source gap is real, but deciding whether the boundary owns only durable accounting or also status snapshots, outcome metadata, auth-profile rotation, memory flush state, and recovery events is a product and architecture choice.

options.title: Design the boundary first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item and define the field ownership plus monotonic/idempotent semantics before implementation.

options.title: Limit to narrow bugs
options.body: Keep the count-only repair and handle each stale status or activity field through focused follow-up issues without a general event boundary.

options.title: Declare current behavior sufficient
options.body: Close the broad follow-up if maintainers intentionally want only the count reconciliation and no shared completion boundary.

recommendation.title: Design the boundary first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item and define the field ownership plus monotonic/idempotent semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and authored key parts of the precursor late-success reconciliation fix and have the clearest direct history on this boundary.
